Description: 
 
   Project Architect | Commercial Design
  
Full Time | Architecture | Commercial Projects
  

  

   Elizabeth Banzhaf, LPN 
  

   Co-Founder & COO | Heartline Staffing 
  

   Call or Text: 272-230-3157
  

   LinkedIn: View Elizabeth's LinkedIn
  
Prefer a confidential conversation instead of applying? Call or text Elizabeth directly at 272-230-3157.
  

  

   Heartline Staffing, in partnership with Purple Cow Recruiting, is hiring a Project Architect for Popli Design Group in Rochester, New York. 
  

  
POSITION OVERVIEW
  

   Popli Design Group is seeking an experienced, licensed Project Architect to lead the architectural design, documentation, and technical coordination of commercial and multidisciplinary projects. This is a hands-on design position for an architect who wants to remain actively involved in project development rather than working exclusively in project management. 
  

  

   The Project Architect will oversee architectural work from design development through permitting, construction administration, and project closeout. This individual will coordinate with internal engineering disciplines, external consultants, clients, contractors, and governing agencies while ensuring that project documents meet applicable building codes, client expectations, and Popli Design Group standards. 
  

  

   The successful candidate will provide technical leadership, maintain project momentum when the Project Manager is unavailable, supervise junior architectural staff on a project basis, and balance design responsibilities with team coordination and client communication. 
  

  

   Key responsibilities include: 
  

  
   Lead the architectural design and production of commercial and multidisciplinary projects
   Remain actively involved in hands-on design, technical documentation, and drawing production
   Coordinate architectural work with internal engineering teams, external consultants, clients, contractors, and governing agencies
   Prepare and oversee complete project documentation for client approvals and state or local permits
   Ensure drawings and specifications meet applicable building codes, project requirements, and company standards
   Organize project workloads and develop redlines for junior architectural staff to implement
   Review staff work and provide regular feedback, mentorship, and technical guidance
   Coordinate closely with Project Managers regarding staffing needs, project priorities, design progress, and deadlines
   Maintain project momentum and make appropriate technical decisions when the Project Manager is unavailable
   Perform construction site visits and project walkthroughs
   Review RFIs, shop drawings, submittals, and contractor questions during construction
   Issue supplementary instructions and help resolve design or construction conflicts
   Confirm that contractor work aligns with contract documents and project specifications
   Review project closeout documentation and support final project completion
   Select and apply appropriate architectural procedures, technical methods, and design solutions
   Prepare clear meeting minutes, reports, correspondence, and project documentation
   Assist with value-engineering efforts while protecting design quality, functionality, and code compliance
  
  
 COMPENSATION
  

  
   $80,000-$120,000 Annual Salary
   Final compensation will be based on experience, licensure, technical expertise, and overall qualifications
  
  
 SCHEDULE
  

  
   Full-Time Position
   On-Site at the Rochester, New York Office
   No Remote Work
   Local travel to project sites is required
  
  
 WHY ARCHITECTURE PROFESSIONALS ARE APPLYING
  

  
   Join Popli Design Group, a multidisciplinary architecture and engineering firm serving clients since 1982
   Work within an established organization with seven offices across New York State
   Remain actively involved in architectural design and documentation rather than moving into a fully administrative project-management role
   Lead commercial and multidisciplinary projects from design development through construction completion
   Collaborate directly with architects, engineers, consultants, clients, contractors, and governing agencies
   Mentor junior architectural professionals and influence the technical development of project teams
   Apply advanced architectural judgment while maintaining meaningful involvement in daily project design
   Participate in construction administration, site visits, code compliance, permitting, and project closeout
   Build a long-term career with an established firm known for quality, professionalism, and integrity
  
  
 BENEFITS
  

  
   Full-Time Direct-Hire Employment
   Long-Term Professional Growth Opportunity
   Project Leadership and Mentorship Responsibilities
   Exposure to Commercial and Multidisciplinary Projects
   Benefits package details will be confirmed during the interview process
  
 
 

  Requirements: 
 
  Professional Architect License REQUIRED
  New York State Architect License Preferred; Candidates Must Be Able to Obtain New York Reciprocity Within 6 Months REQUIRED
  Minimum 6 Years of Hands-On Architectural Design and Documentation Experience REQUIRED
  Predominantly Hands-On Design Experience Rather Than Exclusively Project Management Experience REQUIRED
  Commercial, Institutional, Civic, Industrial, or Other Non-Residential Project Experience REQUIRED
  Residential-Only Architecture Experience Does Not Meet the Position Requirements
  Five-Year NAAB-Accredited Architecture Degree or an Equivalent Combination of Education and Relevant Professional Experience REQUIRED
  Experience Leading the Development and Production of Architectural Documents REQUIRED
  Experience Coordinating Multidisciplinary Projects with Engineers, Consultants, Clients, Contractors, and Governing Agencies REQUIRED
  Strong Knowledge of Building Codes, Permit Documentation, Construction Documents, and Technical Standards REQUIRED
  Ability to Lead Projects and Maintain Progress When the Project Manager Is Unavailable REQUIRED
  Experience Developing Redlines, Reviewing Staff Work, and Mentoring Junior Architectural Staff REQUIRED
  Proficiency in AutoCAD REQUIRED
  Proficiency in Revit REQUIRED
  Proficiency in Bluebeam REQUIRED
  Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite REQUIRED
  Proficiency in New York State Energy Software REQUIRED
  Strong Written, Verbal, Technical, and Client-Facing Communication Skills REQUIRED
  Ability to Read and Interpret Complex Technical Documents, Drawings, Codes, and Specifications REQUIRED
  Ability to Prepare Professional Reports, Meeting Minutes, Emails, Memos, and Project Correspondence REQUIRED
  Valid Driver's License and Acceptable Motor Vehicle Record REQUIRED
  Ability to Travel to Construction Sites and Attend Project Walkthroughs REQUIRED
  Ability to Work Full Time On-Site in the Rochester, New York Office REQUIRED
  Remote Work Is Not Available for This Position
  United States Citizenship or Permanent Resident Status REQUIRED
  Advanced Construction Administration Experience Preferred
  Experience Reviewing RFIs, Shop Drawings, Submittals, and Closeout Documentation Preferred
  Experience Organizing Workload Assignments and Supporting Value-Engineering Efforts Preferred
 
 

  Not ready to formally apply? That's okay. Many architecture professionals prefer a confidential conversation first. Call or text Elizabeth Banzhaf directly at 272-230-3157 to discuss the position privately. 
 

 

  Heartline Staffing is a Strategic Talent Partner with Purple Cow Recruiting. Applications are securely tracked and reviewed through our applicant-tracking system. Qualified candidates will be contacted directly regarding next steps.
